forbidden_patterns.reason: OWASP A03: eval() with user input enables arbitrary code execution (XSS / RCE).
forbidden_patterns.remediation: Remove eval(). Use JSON.parse() for data parsing, or refactor to avoid dynamic code evaluation.

forbidden_patterns.reason: OWASP A03: Function constructor is equivalent to eval() and allows arbitrary code execution.
forbidden_patterns.remediation: Refactor to use named functions or arrow functions instead of the Function constructor.

forbidden_patterns.reason: OWASP A03 / DISA STIG: Assigning to innerHTML with unsanitized data enables XSS attacks.
forbidden_patterns.remediation: Use element.textContent for plain text, or sanitize HTML with DOMPurify.sanitize() before assigning to innerHTML.

forbidden_patterns.reason: OWASP A03: document.write() with dynamic content enables XSS attacks.
forbidden_patterns.remediation: Remove document.write(). Use DOM manipulation methods (createElement, appendChild, textContent) instead.

forbidden_patterns.reason: OWASP A08 / CIS Benchmark: Setting __proto__ enables prototype pollution attacks.
forbidden_patterns.remediation: Never merge user-supplied objects that contain __proto__. Use Object.create(null) for data containers and validate JSON input keys against a whitelist.

forbidden_patterns.reason: FIPS 140-3 / NIST SP 800-90A: Math.random() is not cryptographically secure and must not be used for tokens, keys, or security operations.
forbidden_patterns.remediation: Use the Web Crypto API: crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(32)) or crypto.randomUUID() for security-sensitive random values.

forbidden_patterns.reason: OWASP A03: child_process.exec() invokes a shell and is vulnerable to command injection.
forbidden_patterns.remediation: Use child_process.execFile() or child_process.spawn() with an argument array and shell: false to avoid shell injection.

forbidden_patterns.reason: OWASP A02 / CIS Benchmark: Storing authentication tokens in localStorage exposes them to XSS attacks.
forbidden_patterns.remediation: Store authentication tokens in HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite cookies instead of localStorage or sessionStorage.

forbidden_patterns.reason: OWASP A02: Storing tokens in sessionStorage exposes them to XSS attacks.
forbidden_patterns.remediation: Store authentication tokens in HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite cookies instead of sessionStorage.

forbidden_patterns.reason: OWASP A03: child_process.exec() in Node.js is vulnerable to shell injection.
forbidden_patterns.remediation: Use execFile() or spawn() with an array of arguments and shell: false.

forbidden_patterns.reason: FIPS 140-3 / STIG V-222645: MD5 is cryptographically broken and not FIPS-compliant.
forbidden_patterns.remediation: Use the Web Crypto API with SHA-256: crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', data).

forbidden_patterns.reason: OWASP A07 / NIST IA-5: Hardcoded password detected in source code.
forbidden_patterns.remediation: Remove hardcoded passwords. Load credentials from environment variables (process.env.DB_PASSWORD) or a secrets manager.
